measurement_note: Size is the number r of parking transaction rows. One car visits r distinct lots for strictly increasing durations, so every row survives the car-lot aggregation. Grouping plus window ranking takes O(r log r) time, while a correct correlated anti-join over the lot summaries takes O(r^2) time.
